Note that section 4.4 mentions Enterprise customers may request higher limits, so 600/min is the standard default rather than an absolute ceiling.

question: How much can I spend per year on conferences and online courses for my own development?
text:
**$1,800 per calendar year.**

Per the Benefits Summary, Plan Year 2026 (doc `benefits-summary-2026`, lines 33–35), each full-time employee may spend up to **$1,800 per calendar year** on learning related to their current role or a role they're working toward. Eligible expenses include:

- Event (conference) registration fees
- Coursework (including online courses)
- Certification examinations
- Books

A few important conditions:

- **Manager approval** is required for each use, submitted in Ledgerly.
- **Travel, lodging, and meals** for an approved conference are *not* charged to this allowance — they're business travel under the Travel and Expense Policy (doc `expense-policy-2026`, section 10), charged to your team's travel budget.
- **No carryover** — unused amounts don't roll over to the next year.
- **Prorated in your first year** by quarter of hire.
- If you're **speaking at a conference on behalf of the company**, the registration is handled differently — see section 10 of the Travel and Expense Policy for details.
